title: Case 024: Confirmation of a Recorded Payment
initial_request: I can see that my payment is recorded on the insurer's system. Please could you obtain and send me a receipt for it?
overview: Ryan Ellis asked his broker, Faye at Redmere Risk, for a receipt because Alder Crown Insurance's system showed his payment as recorded. Faye asked the insurer's Payment Team to provide a receipt against that record, received receipt RCP-024 as receipt.png for £286.40 paid on 11 June 2025, and forwarded it to Ryan, who confirmed that he received it.

next_action.summary: Request the receipt for the recorded payment from Alder Crown Insurance's authorized Payment Team.

outcome: Ryan confirmed that he received the payment receipt.

events.body: Alder Crown Insurance's system shows my payment as recorded, but I do not have a receipt. Could you please ask them to send one for the payment relating to 124 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 6ZZ?

Ryan Ellis has asked for a receipt for the payment recorded on his property account for 124 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 6ZZ. Please check the payment record and provide the corresponding receipt; we need a receipt rather than an invoice.

We have checked the £286.40 payment recorded on 11 June 2025 and are sending receipt RCP-024 as receipt.png. It records the payment against Ryan Ellis's property at 124 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 6ZZ.

Alder Crown Insurance's Payment Team has provided the receipt for the payment recorded on your account. I have forwarded receipt.png, RCP-024, for the £286.40 payment dated 11 June 2025 on 124 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 6ZZ.
I received receipt.png, thank you. That is the payment receipt I was asking for.
